ios.name: Pitch Perfect
ios.subtitle: A pitch pipe for singers
ios.description:
Find your starting note with a digital pitch pipe. Play individual notes or chords, see note names and frequencies, and match major or minor key signatures to their starting pitches.

Keep a song list with the pitches you need for rehearsal. Add songs, choose their keys, and arrange them in the order you sing.

Use the pitch pipe widget to sound a note from your Home Screen. Light and dark appearances keep the controls readable on your phone or tablet.
ios.promotional_text: A digital pitch pipe, note selector, and key signatures for your next rehearsal.
